scope: Responsive bowl dragging with safe asynchronous placement validation and preserved layout save/cancel.
cause: Build 6 ran candidate enumeration, feeding approach search and repeated deferred-grid rebuilds synchronously on the main thread for every touch move.
changes: Touches only project the preview onto the existing bowl placement grid and update nodes; no route search or grid creation during moves.
Release resolves a reachable feeding placement on Task.detached using immutable geometry; the selected obstacle grid is returned with the validated position.
Placement stops at the first reachable feeding plan; each candidate reuses its navigation grid across staging points. Actual meals still select the shortest safe plan.

Saving stays disabled during the gesture and validation; cancellation remains available. Revision tokens reject old results after another drag, cancellation, exit, backgrounding or size changes including zero size.
Applying the verified draft skips redundant main-thread revalidation; arrangement requests 60 FPS, normal room returns to 30 FPS.
No save format or art/character scale changes.
